title: Giants LB Tremaine Edmunds ruled out for Week 7, reportedly out for season with shoulder injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Giants LB Tremaine Edmunds ruled out for Week 7, reportedly out for season with shoulder injury
sources.description: The Giants won't have linebacker Tremaine Edmunds in the lineup against the Texans on Sunday and he reportedly will miss the rest of the season.
